What's open on Easter Monday Bebe HodgesCincinnati EnquirerApril 6, 2026, 7:47 a.m. ET0:27/0:46Keep WatchingCurious if Easter Monday will affect your errands?We don't blame you. The United States government celebrates many holidays on a different day than the actual holiday date. For example, if Independence Day falls on a Sunday, it is observed the following Monday.Well, does the government do the same for Easter? Are banks and post offices closed today? Here's what to know.Is today a holiday?Easter Monday is not a federal holiday in the United States. Christmas Day is the only religious federal holiday in the United States. Easter Monday is a public holiday in many other countries, including Canada and parts of the United Kingdom.Are banks open today?Yes. Easter Monday is not a federal holiday.Is the post office open today?Yes.Does the mail run on Easter Monday?Yes.Are schools open on Easter Monday?Some schools may be closed on Easter Monday, especially if the holiday falls on the school's spring break. It's best to check your school or district's calendar.Is the stock market open on Easter Monday?Yes. The Nasdaq and the New York Stock Exchange operate normal hours on Easter Monday.
